blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In celebration of its 17th anniversary, Manila Water Non-East Zone operating unit Laguna Water launched an expanded implementation of its Daloy ng Saya program months ahead of its traditional year-end schedule, enabling the company to reach more learners through a strategic partnership with the Sangguniang Panlalawigan ng Laguna. Daloy ng Saya has served as Laguna Water’s platform for promoting awareness on wise water use, proper sanitation, and environmental stewardship. This year, the program was rolled out earlier to maximize its impact and extend its reach beyond the Company’s service areas. The expanded implementation was made possible through the support […]...
